lines.zh: 身体变小了，步子也短了。
lines.en: My body shrank, so my steps got shorter.

lines.zh: 我得走快些才跟得上别人。
lines.en: I have to walk fast just to keep up.
A little off the ground, I slide along.

lines.zh: 这双腿走路太多，跳着更快。
lines.en: These legs walk too much; hopping is quicker.
I jog along with my hair flying.
I'm short, so the grass reaches my chest.

lines.zh: 我踩着石头，一格一格跳。
lines.en: I hop stone to stone, one block at a time.

lines.zh: 我抬头找路，看不清太远。
lines.en: I look for the way; I can't see far.
My steps are quick and quiet.
Small as I am, I still walk with some swagger.
I'll take the front; don't fall behind.
I sit, and my legs don't reach the ground.
I plant my hands on my hips.
My stomach growls again.
I look up; the clouds look huge.
I try gathering ki in my palm.
Small body, no small strength.
Wind blows my hair into my face.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来看地上的虫子。
lines.en: I crouch to look at a bug.
I yawn, quietly.
I'm still not used to this body.
I tighten my laces.

lines.zh: 我在数自己有几根手指。
lines.en: I'm counting my own fingers.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸头顶，还是那样。
lines.en: I touch my head; still the same.
I look up at you.

lines.zh: 你得蹲下来我才好说话。
lines.en: You'll have to crouch for us to talk.
Hands on hips, I stand in front of you.
Don't underestimate me because I'm small.
You're unfamiliar; I haven't seen you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，只到你腰那么高。
lines.en: My raised hand only reaches your waist.
If you want a fight, I won't dodge.
You smell of food.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候脖子都酸了。
lines.en: Looking up at you makes my neck ache.

lines.zh: 我后退一步，才看清你的脸。
lines.en: I step back to see your whole face.
I smile; no ill intent.
I don't like having to look up.

lines.zh: 我们站一起，差得太多了。
lines.en: Side by side, the difference is obvious.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，尽量显得高。
lines.en: I lift my chin to seem taller.
I double over from the pain.
That blow was taller than I am.
Not the head — it hurts for ages.
I bite down and don't cry out.
Dust shakes off me all over.
I raise my arms, but they're too short.
Blood drips onto my shoe.
I'm still on my feet.
Small bodies are tough too.
Smells so good my stomach is growling.
Could I have a little?
I'm holding out both hands.
That little? Not enough for me.
I won't be polite; first bite is mine.
I get it all over my face.
Small frame, big appetite.
I'll talk after I eat.
You make this really well.
I'll leave you the last bite.

lines.zh: 被你一撞，我翻了个跟头。
lines.en: You knock me and I roll head over heels.

lines.zh: 我太矮，你差点没看见我。
lines.en: I'm so short you nearly missed me.
Steady now — I'm fine.
I bounce off, land, and hold.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣服才没倒。
lines.en: I grab your clothes to keep from falling.
That pushed me back two steps.
I look up and you're looking down.
Watch your step — I'm right here.
Small bodies still have weight.
This body makes everything awkward.
I'm thinking of the table at home.
Someone told me not to wander off.
I promised I'd come back.
This much I remember.
Fighting is easy; going home is hard.
I have to grow up first.
Thinking of it, I stop rushing.
I wrap my belt one more turn.
It takes both hands for me to hold it.
I have to stand on tiptoe to reach.
It fell; I caught it.
I snatch it up fast.
This rock is bigger than my head.
I carry it a few steps in my arms.
Can't manage it, so I put it down.
One look, then I toss it.
Your ki just moved.
I'm small, but I can fight.
I crouch very low.
One push and I launch.

lines.zh: 我锁定你的腰，那里好打。
lines.en: I pick your waist; it's an easy target.
Your opening is down low.
I raise a hand and ki gathers.

lines.zh: 你看不到我，但我知道你在哪。
lines.en: You can't see me, but I know where you are.
You move first; I'll allow it.
I'll hit you from underneath.
You can't guard this angle.
Don't run; I'm quick on my feet.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面绕，个子矮正好。
lines.en: I circle low to the ground; being short helps.
Kick high and you'll miss.
I'm circling at your feet.

lines.zh: 你低头的时候，我已经动了。
lines.en: When you look down, I've already moved.
I keep changing position.
You can't catch me.

lines.zh: 我跳到你身后，又跳回来。
lines.en: I hop behind you and back.

lines.zh: 你的招式都是往下砸的。
lines.en: All your moves swing downward.

lines.zh: 再近一步就进我的距离。
lines.en: One more step and you're in my range.
When you lift a foot, I slip through.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，越来越近。
lines.en: I circle you, closer each pass.
I keep hopping; you can't land one.
Small as I am, I can still catch you.
I hug the ground where you can't reach.

lines.zh: 这一圈绕完就到你背后。
lines.en: One more lap and I'm behind you.
Your ki is ragged; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，一拳打在你腰上。
lines.en: I leap and punch your waist.
Small frame, solid hit.
I kick your knee from below.
A small ki blast bursts in my palm.
My elbow digs under your ribs.
Three quick strikes, all fast.
I bounce off and land on my feet.
If you back off, I follow.
My hits are small, but they hurt.
The last kick lands square on the chest.
I keep kicking your ankle.
My palm shoves your leg.

lines.zh: 我跳上去，抓住你的袖子。
lines.en: I leap and grab your sleeve.

lines.zh: 落地的声音很小，力道不小。
lines.en: The landing is quiet; the hit isn't.

lines.zh: 我从光里掉下来，摔了个屁股。
lines.en: I drop out of the light and land on my rear.
My hands and feet have shrunk.
I get up and dust myself off.
Everything here is so big.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，脖子都酸了。
lines.en: I look up at the sky and my neck aches.
My ki is still here — good.
I try a jump; it goes pretty high.
The soil here is dry and hard.

lines.zh: 远处的人影比我高两倍。
lines.en: The figure out there is twice my height.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸头，头发还是黑的。
lines.en: I touch my head; hair is still black.

lines.zh: 落地的地方留了个小坑。
lines.en: A small crater marks where I landed.
I clench my fist; decent strength.
A gust nearly knocks me over.
I take a deep breath and get ready to go.
Being this small has its perks.
I test two steps; they're steady.

lines.zh: 这里不是我家，但也不坏。
lines.en: Not home, but not bad either.

lines.zh: 火烧到袖子，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I slap it out.
I fall, and the crater is barely deeper than me.

lines.zh: 水到我脖子了，快淹上来。
lines.en: Water's at my neck and still rising.

lines.zh: 我被冲得翻了三个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips me three times over.
The arrow that hit me is almost longer than me.

lines.zh: 有什么东西缠住我的手脚。
lines.en: Something has bound my hands and feet.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整个人跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I jump out of my skin.
